name: pmUSD
oneLiner: pmUSD is RAAC's f(x)-fork dollar fToken minted against TokenBlender/ION.au gold collateral; xPM absorbs volatility and sUSDS-based PSM defends the peg.
collateral: TokenBlender (TB) base token held on-chain in RAAC's RWf(x) Treasury; TB is minted against I-ON Digital's ION.au token held in the TokenBlender contract, and ION.au represents a gold-backed digital security and in-situ gold claim
pegMechanism: RWf(x), an f(x) protocol fork, mints pmUSD as the fToken against TB / ION.au-linked collateral; xPM absorbs collateral-price volatility while pmUSD is configured for stable fNAV; minting and system operations are manager-only through authorized silo multisigs. PSM (Peg Stability Module) is the primary peg defense tool: arbitrageurs swap pmUSD → sUSDS at $1 face value when pmUSD trades at a discount on-chain; swaps are one-directional and pause if the sUSDS reserve falls below 20% of PSM assets

oracleRisk.summary: pmUSD uses an external gold-linked price for RWf(x) treasury accounting, but RAAC explicitly disables liquidation and self-liquidation, so there is no external liquidation-oracle branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: RAAC documents pmUSD as a manager-only RWf(x) fToken where xPM absorbs collateral-price volatility, the treasury reads an Instruxi/Chainlink-linked RWA price, and all liquidation and self-liquidation mechanisms are disabled. Under-collateralization instead blocks operations and permits pro-rata fToken redemption, so collateral liquidation branches are not applicable.

mintAuthority.summary: pmUSD minting is gated by the f(x) Treasury contract (0x51c4348a…). The Treasury holds a fToken() pointer to pmUSD and is the exclusive minter; its owner and the proxy admin owner for both pmUSD and the Market contract is a single RAAC 2/3 Safe (0xCa3144AAD…).

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294813: treasury.owner(), proxy admin 0x89ab60d8….owner(), and Market proxy admin 0x89ab60d8….owner() all returned 0xCa3144AAD… Safe API: threshold 2, 3 owners, no enabled modules, zero guard, masterCopy 0x41675C….

sources.label: SEC filing for RAAC commercial counterparty

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294813: pmUSD.treasury()=0x51c4348a…; treasury.fToken()=pmUSD token address; treasury.owner()=RAAC Safe 0xCa3144AAD…; pmUSD proxy admin owner=same Safe; Market (0x4e8ef157…) proxy admin owner=same Safe. Safe API confirmed 2/3, no modules, no guard. No credible recurring reconciliation was established. The RAAC whitepaper and the SEC-filed commercial agreement describe pmUSD/ION.au mechanics and business arrangements, but neither provides a dated, recurring third-party reconciliation of pmUSD supply to backing assets; a market-price oracle is not reserve reconciliation. The reviewed SEC corporate filing is not prudential supervision of the token issuer or product, and no exact registry-backed prudential supervisor was identified. Reviewed 2026-07-15.
